text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.orig_text: こンのファッションおツンデレアイドルッ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: You're one to talk, you walking fashion disaster young lady!
text_block_list.orig_text: そっちはファッションセンス壊滅令嬢じゃないですかっ！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Those two never learn, do they?
text_block_list.orig_text: あのお二人も懲りないですね～

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: My Lord Kishi, how do you find Kanon these days?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿や。
近時のカノン奴は
如何な有様で御座んしょう？

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaah! Being called a good girl is so pathetic!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーっ、
いい子とか
くっっ
だらねぇですわ～～～～！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: What's even remotely "good" about this girl, Kishi-san?!
text_block_list.orig_text: これのどこがいい子なんですか騎士さん！？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Korokorokorokoro. You are most certainly right... even to my eyes, it appears as if things are indeed moving towards a good direction.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コロコロコロ。
そうさ喃──
わっちの目にも、
確かに善き方向へ
転びつつあるように映りんす。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Then henceforth, I entrust all her further discipline to you, Lord Kishi. If you can provide her with good guidance, then maybe Kanon will be able to steer herself to a proper attitude... Or maybe not.
text_block_list.orig_text:
では引き続き、
此れより先の躾も
騎士殿に一任いたしんしょう。
薫陶よろしきを得ること叶えば、
カノン奴の器も整う……
やも、
しれませぬ故。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: THAT SELF PROCLAIMED GUARDIAN ATTITUDE OF YOURS TOWARDS ME PISSES ME OFF THE MOST!!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: その保護者気取りが一番腹立たしいんですわよ～～～～ッ！！
